Engine repair and engine overhaul

Engine overhaul in Subang Jaya and Shah Alam, from mountings to a full rebuild.

Engine repair and overhaul

We take engines out, rebuild them and put them back. Our photos show Rolls-Royce engines on the floor during an overhaul, and a Porsche GT3 engine repair.

Gearbox and drivetrain

Gearbox repair and ATF service, flywheel work and engine mounting, on cars like the BMW X5 F15, Porsche Macan and Mercedes-Benz GTS.

Major service

Major car service and timing belt jobs, done in the same bay as our heavier engine work.

Questions

Do you do full engine overhauls?

Yes. Engine overhaul is one of our main services at the Shah Alam HQ and the Subang Jaya branch.

Do you repair gearboxes?

Yes. We have done gearbox repair and ATF service on BMW, Porsche and Mercedes-Benz cars.
